@fumatl at Star Metals is contemporary Italian from a Michelin-recognized Miami hospitality team, and the vibe feels like is so good. Think handmade pasta being rolled right in front of you, a vinyl DJ set spinning in front of the pasta station, and a curing room lined with dried meats that looks like art. 

It’s intimate, cozy, and low-lit in the best way. I’d absolutely sip wine and meander my way through the menu, staying longer than planned. Perfect for an elevated girls’ night or a walkable West Midtown date night before or after drinks nearby. 

If you love spots with an open kitchen, music, and chefs at work, this one’s worth adding to this list. We had creamy gnocchi, fresh oysters, tuna carpaccio, and an insane 60 day dry-aged grassed ribeye.

@azaraatl is the newest rooftop dining to hit Atlanta & it’s in a prime spot! ✨ 

This new rooftop restaurant blends elevated Mediterranean flavors with a level of intention you rarely find. Fun fact: Dr. Raj Pandya is an orthopedic surgeon and founder of Azara. The whole concept is built around longevity, wellness, and evidence-based nutrition, which he has done by leaning into his medical background & focusing on nutrient-rich ingredients and “longevity hotspots” inspired diets (places where people live longer). You can tell there’s real care behind the sourcing, flavors, and overall experience.

Are you inspired yet?? @azaraatl has roasted cauliflower steak, globally inspired small plates, fresh seafood, and veggie-forward dishes inspired by longevity regions like Sardinia and Okinawa. Of course, don’t skip a cocktail or glass of wine for sunset!

The space feels like one of those breezy rooftops you’d take friends from out of town or plan a walkable date night around. Think skyline views, warm ambiance, and an elevated health-forward menu 🫶 warm weather is around the corner after all!

A new kind of wellness space has come to Atlanta and it’s everything you’d want it to be 👇

@lumivita_buckhead is built around a proactive approach to feeling your best ✨ think hormone support, recovery, aesthetics, and longevity-focused treatments all under one roof, designed to support you for the long run. Essentially, they’re making it easy for us!

The atmosphere is calm, intentional, and elevated with cozy rooms for each of the services offered. It doesn’t feel like a clinic, but instead felt like an escape from our busy city (seeing how this is in the heart of buckhead with one coming to midtown soon)! I went for an organic massage with lymphatic drainage and a scalp massage, which was 75 minutes of pure bliss & relaxation. So you’re covered whether you’re looking for day spa or med spa services 🫶

Want to know the best part?? They also just opened a very limited founding membership for the first wave (only open to 100 people) with exclusive access, insider pricing, and perks that won’t be offered later. Is this proof that eating well and eating pizza can coexist??

If you’re starting off the new year with a focus on eating well, I’m here to remind you about the always yummy, always fresh @mistero1pizza. ✨🍕 They have two locations, one in Buckhead and one in Sandy Springs. It’s pretty incredible because every pizza starts with fresh, high-quality ingredients (most imported from Italy or sourced locally), and everything is prepared fresh daily!

The pizzas are thin & crispy and made via 72-hour dough fermentation for a lighter, easier-to-digest crust. They’re known for the star shaped crust which earned the owner an O1 visa here in the states. They also avoid adding sugar or preservatives to the dough or sauces and carefully select ingredients like premium cheeses, fresh vegetables, and quality meats. I haven’t met a pizza I didn’t like there yet. My favorites being the Star Luca, Coffee Paola, Elisa, and Mimmo. 

And for anyone actually paying attention to what they’re eating this year, their nutritional facts button breaks down calories and macros, which is honestly such a win!

The pizza is on the Michelin recommended list for their original Miami location. So if you haven’t yet, you gotta go! 

No reservations needed, just show up hungry to @mistero1pizza. 📍6405 Blue Stone Rd Ste 240 Sandy Springs, GA 30328 📍 3699 Lenox Rd NE Ste 2, Atlanta, GA 30305

Friendly reminder there is a cool listening bar called @echoroomatl in west midtown with music specially curated by local legends. It’s a hi-fi vinyl listening bar where people gather to dance and listen to good music. Find them inside of @westside_motor_lounge. It was more lowkey when I visited with people really there for the music. Head to their page to see upcoming events. 

@luckystaratl is a stylish cafe by day thay transforms to a cool cocktail bar with an incredible Taiwanese menu at night. Have you been yet?? You can reserve a seat at the bar w @resy and watch the magic behind the incredible drink making. Think foraged ingredients, some cool sciencey stuff, and a spin on Southeast Asian flavors. Make note this is one of the best spots in town for NA cocktails as it’s goes way beyond your typical juice forward, citrusy substitutes. You’ll want to bring your friends so you can try one of everything. @chefjasonliang (behind @michelinguide starred @brushatl) pays homage to his roots and it’s sure to provide some comfort & warmth to you in this chilly weather. Find them in @starmetalsatl (walk past torchys). 

In case you missed it - there is a cocktail bar hidden under @hotelgranada_atlanta in midtown & it’s a vibeeee. @maypeel_atlanta is dark & moody in the best way with comfortable seating and deep blue walls. The cocktails were unique like their take on the pisco sour with matcha and strawberry-peychaud’s foam (it’s tart and citrusy if that’s ur thing!). There are light bites if you get hungry or you can dine on the outdoor patio of Pom Court @hotelgranada_atlanta then sneak downstairs for a night cap. You can valet or find garage parking nearby.

💫NEW YEARS EVE IN ATL💫

This is a one-night, prix-fixe experience where the most delicious ingredients live together on a single menu (no supplement games here)

@avize.atl has created a menu full of the best ingredients, like caviar, white truffles, lobster, and the wagyu (without forcing you into add-ons bc it’s automatically included at an accessible price). Paired with a curated wine program, it’s guaranteed to be the perfect night out. 

NYE Details 🥂
• Exclusive New Year’s Eve menu only
• No regular dinner service (vegetarian options available)
• Seatings at 6PM & 9PM
• 9PM seating includes a complimentary champagne toast + midnight surprise
• $195 | $250 with wine pairing
• Only 65 reservations available

In case you want to take a peek at the menu ✨
• Arpège Egg – burnt hay, maple, yeast
• Oyster – celeriac, fermented white asparagus, stone pine, caviar 
• Arctic Char – warm cider ponzu, caraway, shiso, mutsu apple, wasabi
• Truffle Risotto – koshihikari rice, shiro dashi, white truffle pâté
A definitive classic, reimagined with koji, shiro dashi, over-aged parmesan, and Alba white truffles (give me 10 of them)
• Bread & Butter Cart – cultured butter, black garlic butter, rye sourdough, fermented carrot brioche, pretzel
• Lobster – mandarin, carrot, curry
Fresh live lobsters processed just before service, finished with a rich carrot red curry made from the bodies, Madeira, peak-season local citrus, and uni
• Black Opal Australian Wagyu – A5 tartar, rosti, smoked mushroom, oxtail jus
South Australian barley-fed Wagyu alongside Japanese A5 on a rosti hashbrown, finished with braised oxtail jus seasoned with tawny port, black garlic, and smoked mushrooms
• Chocolate Dessert – kishu satsuma, gianduja, rhum chantilly

It wasn’t until recently that I learned about a Boodle Fight @boodlefightatl , which is a longstanding tradition in Filipino culture. It’s a vibrant feast set atop banana leaves to be shared by hand with friends and family. Chef Dave Denina at @brickandmortaratlanta taught me it was originally intended to build camaraderie by getting military personnel to enjoy the same food together, regardless of rank. He is now sharing part of his culture with us here in Atlanta. The Boodle Fight at Brick & Mortar is a unique way to share a meal with your loved ones and continue the celebration of camaraderie, brotherhood, and equality.

There will be 7 rounds of Boodle Fight coming up with the first ones kicking off at @brickandmortaratlanta on 2/14, 2/21, 2/28 (head to the link in their bio to sign up). It is $75 pp & you can expect shrimp skewers, pork belly, lumpia, tropical fruits, steamed bok choy and more on the table!

@scadfash museum of fashion is one to add to your list of things to do in Atlanta. I had no idea this museum offers some of the best views of the city along with really cool rotating exhibits. There is still time to catch the work of two incredible designers @imane_ayissi and @thesandypowell.

There are over 40 signature looks that all tell a story about Africa’s larger contributions to fashion while expanding understandings of global luxury.  It’s a must see! His pieces have been worn by some familiar names like @zendaya and more. 

You’re also sure to recognize some pieces from @thesandypowell Dressing the Part: Costume Design for Film which will be on view until March 16th. Wander through her various designs over her 40-year career of storytelling within a series of vignettes featuring more than 70 costumes from nearly 30 films, including Shakespeare in Love, The Wolf of Wall Street, and How to Talk to Girls at Parties. Some of the pieces being award winning designs! You’re sure to recognize the iconic Cinderella dress that took over 50 days to make.
